profile_fields.title: Climate Change Impacts on Biodiversity in Tropical Ecosystems
profile_fields.abstract: Tropical ecosystems are among the most biodiverse regions on Earth, yet they face unprecedented threats from climate change. This study examines the impact of rising temperatures and changing precipitation patterns on species richness and ecosystem functioning across three tropical forest sites. Our findings indicate significant shifts in species composition and ecosystem services.
